test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (Quant) (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: maths
question: The monthly salary of a person was Rs. 1,60,000. He used to spend on three heads — Personal and family expenses (P), Taxes (T) and Education loan (E). The rest were his savings. P was 50% of the income. E was 20% of P, and T was 15% of E. When his salary got raised by 30%, he maintained the percentage level of P, but E became 30% of P and T became 20% of E. The sum of the two savings (in Rs.) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Savings % (Old) = 100% − [50% + (20% of 50%) + (15% of 10%)] = 100% − 61.5% = 38.5%

Savings 1 = 38.5% of 1,60,000 = ₹61,600

New Salary = 1.30 × 1,60,000 = ₹2,08,000

Savings % (New) = 100% − [50% + (30% of 50%) + (20% of 15%)] = 100% − 68% = 32%

Savings 2 = 32% of 2,08,000 = ₹66,560

Total Savings = 61,600 + 66,560 = ₹1,28,160

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,28,160.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Salary = ₹1,60,000

Expenses: P = 50% of Income, E = 20% of P, T = 15% of E

New Salary = Initial × 130%

New Expenses: P = 50% of Income, E = 30% of P, T = 20% of E

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ead4e4d5f6f57d2df74cfe50b9a151acf31224ffb863293a456c2b8113a106bf.png] 

**Step 1: Calculate Initial Savings**

⇒ P₁ = 50% of 1,60,000 = ₹80,000

⇒ E₁ = 20% of 80,000 = ₹16,000

⇒ T₁ = 15% of 16,000 = ₹2,400

⇒ Savings₁ = 1,60,000 − (80,000 + 16,000 + 2,400) = ₹61,600

**Step 2: Calculate New Savings after 30% Raise**

⇒ New Salary = 1,60,000 × 1.3 = ₹2,08,000

⇒ P₂ = 50% of 2,08,000 = ₹1,04,000

⇒ E₂ = 30% of 1,04,000 = ₹31,200

⇒ T₂ = 20% of 31,200 = ₹6,240

⇒ Savings₂ = 2,08,000 − (1,04,000 + 31,200 + 6,240) = ₹66,560

**Step 3: Calculate the Sum**

⇒ Total Savings = 61,600 + 66,560 = ₹1,28,160

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,28,160.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage of Percentage

When a value is a percentage of another percentage, multiply the decimals: x% of y% of Total = (x/100) × (y/100) × Total.

Successive Increment

A salary raise of r% is calculated as: New Salary = Original Salary × (1 + r/100).

Savings Calculation

Savings = Total Income − Sum of all individual expenses (P + E + T + ...).
